title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues a structural analysis of an algebraic group scheme M_{ρ,σ} over a base S. It belongs to the 'variations sur l'équation des lacets', part of the continuation of La Longue Marche, which studies GL(2)-type representations attached to the loop equation. On the previous page Grothendieck took a homomorphism θ: M_{ρ,σ} → G ≅ GL(2)_S and proved it is an epimorphism. Its image contains SG = SL(2). The composite with det is the projection (α,β,μ,ε) ↦ μ onto 𝔾_m, which is also an epimorphism.

(9) He records a morphism of short exact sequences. The top row is 1 → M^+_{ρ,σ} → M_{ρ,σ} → 𝔾_m → 1, where M^+ is the kernel called M^* on the previous page. The bottom row is 1 → SG → G --det--> 𝔾_m → 1. The vertical maps are induced by θ, with identity (originally written det, then struck) on 𝔾_m. He notes it should be compared with §39, p. 299, formula (1).

Next comes a dimension count, read as 'plat de dimension relative', not 'dites relations'. M_{ρ,σ} is flat of relative dimension 6 and G of relative dimension 4. Hence the kernel I_{ρ,σ} of the epimorphism θ is flat of relative dimension 2. I is contained in J_{ρ,σ}, the kernel of the composite M → G → PG = PGL(2), which has relative dimension 3. This gives (10): 1 → I → J → 𝔾_m → 1, where 𝔾_m is the centre of GL(2) = ker(G → PG). It also gives a composition series (11): 1 ⊂ I ⊂ J ⊂ M, with M/J ≅ PG ≅ SG/μ_2 and M/I ≅ G.

He then announces the expected structure. J plays the role of a 'radical'. It should be commutative, with neutral component of relative dimension 3. It should be a torus when T°_ρ and T°_σ are tori (this condition is on the next page).

The next page shows he regarded this route as over-sophisticated. He re-derives everything directly from the embedding M_{ρ,σ} ⊂ T_ρ × N'_σ × G, cut out by det f = det y = ε' det x with ε'^2 = 1. The dimension count is consistent with this: 2+2+4 minus 2 conditions gives 6. In short, the page is a Levi-type dévissage of a concrete group scheme into a reductive quotient GL(2) or PGL(2) and an expected commutative, multiplicative-type 'radical'.
errors: The machine transcription has \hat{Z}^* in diagram (9) and in (10). The image (and the previous page) has 𝔾_m, the multiplicative group, as target of det and μ. It is not the profinite units.
Minor notational drift: the kernel of M→𝔾_m is called M^*_{ρ,σ} on the previous page and M^+_{ρ,σ} here.
The rightmost vertical arrow was first labelled det and then struck out. It should be the identity of 𝔾_m, consistent with the compatibility shown on the previous page.

The claims that J is commutative and toric are stated as expectations ('on prévoit'), not proved. The next page's description (14) seems to mix up the roles of I and J: the set with λ, of relative dimension 3, matches J rather than I. This is a working-note slip.

ideas.what: Morphism of exact sequences comparing M_{ρ,σ} → 𝔾_m with det: GL(2) → 𝔾_m.
ideas.modern_name: Morphism of extensions of group schemes

ideas.what: Flatness and relative-dimension count giving that the kernel of an epimorphism of flat group schemes (dim 6 → dim 4) is flat of relative dimension 2.
ideas.modern_name: Fibre-dimension / flatness of kernels of fppf epimorphisms

ideas.what: Composition series 1 ⊂ I ⊂ J ⊂ M with M/J ≅ PGL(2) ≅ SL(2)/μ_2, J/I ≅ 𝔾_m (centre), and J playing the role of a radical (expected commutative, toric).
ideas.modern_name: Levi-type dévissage: radical / reductive quotient of a group scheme
ideas.where_published: This specific group M_{ρ,σ} appears only in the unpublished 'équation des lacets' notes as far as known.

deep.surprise_reason: Routine structural bookkeeping (exact sequences, dimension counts, composition series) for a specific auxiliary group scheme. Grothendieck himself abandons this route on the next page as too roundabout. The only non-public element is the particular group M_{ρ,σ}, but nothing on this page is a new result or connection.
transcription_corrections: Diagram (9) and sequence (10): replace \hat{Z}^* by 𝔾_m.

'Comme M_{ρ,σ} est fait de dites relation 6, et G itou des dites relations 4, la mapping de l'image θ' should read 'Comme M_{ρ,σ} est plat de dimension relative 6, et G itou de dimension relative 4, le noyau de l'épi θ : M_{ρ,σ} → G est nécessairement plat de dimension relative 2. Notons-le I_{ρ,σ}, il est contenu dans le noyau J_{ρ,σ} (de dimension relative 3) du composé'.
'de sorte qu'on a une [?]' should read 'de sorte qu'on a une suite exacte'; 'une suite de composition de M_{ρ,σ}' is correct.
Last line: 'on prévoit qu'il est commutatif, à composantes neutres (de dimension relative 3) — et torique si' (insertion above the line, 'torique' possibly struck and rewritten).
Bottom-left of diagram: 'SG' (written over 'SG_ρ' or similar).
